description: Two series per (session, model, type) that differ only in the experiments.ids array attribute, interleaved in one data point list: each series keeps its own baseline and the per-series deltas are summed into one group. A baseline keyed by (session, model, type) alone would see the counter jump between series (backwards → zeroed, forwards → over-counted). The unchanged series contributes 0 in export 3.
contract: ADR-0016 Changes 2026-10-29 (S5b review V1) R4 ("identified by a hash of all its data-point attributes plus startNs"; "one (session, model, type) can have several series"; "Each series' deltas are summed into its group"; the hash is never written to disk), R3, R5, R6; telemetryAttributes.ts (interactive, experiments.ids array); Vertex AI pricing page (fetched 2026-10-29)
